indeed. This particle has the particle δέ opposed to it, with either a few words interposed or after longer intervals.
In sentences opposed by μέν and δέ, often the same or similar words are repeated.
μέν answering to a following ἀλλά.
μέν answering to a following τέ.
μέν indeed, without a following δέ or another particle answering to it
In fragments where μέν is read, it is often uncertain, given the brevity of most of them, whether δέ or another particle, or none, answered to it.
